svg.text: From one slice to a village that glows: the same verb at four time scales
The child: a cut, a piece onto a plate, a push along
The world: at once: the pie falls into equal pieces with a
'ting'; the box ticks along the rail
The child: a table fed fairly, a box filled right
The world: the buddies munch and hop; a lantern lights in
The child: Opening Night's eleven orders, then the
The world: the long table in the lane, every lantern lit,
the cheer; then midnight, then dawn
The child: a rung a school year: tins, scoops, the
The world: the village grows (new buddies move in); the
recipe book fills; your own order for a friend
